quality.rationale: Open P2 backlog is implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes selectable color-wheel points that do not switch the base color, single-point wheel dragging without changing other points, explicit base-color controls, synchronized HEX/RGB slider input, registered single-color rows with direct Fill/Stroke apply buttons, removal of Colors target/group registration UI, saved multi-color palette rows, CSV/HTML persistence, WebP export, mobile no-overflow, user-facing docs, and QCDS evidence. Cross-browser, real-device, and browser storage quota edge cases remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, browser-local edit state, template, color, saved palette, and custom font storage, and client-side YouTube thumbnail import.

delivery.rationale: TODO and local Issues are closed, implementation and docs are aligned, README and user guide are present, QCDS evidence is recorded, tests/build/runtime gate pass, and docs packaging remains available through the existing workflow. A fresh remote Pages run after this commit remains pending until pushed.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested improvements passed: wheel handle selection no longer changes the base color, dragging one companion point updates only that point, RGB sliders update the palette HEX, registered single colors apply directly through Fill and Stroke row buttons, Colors target/group registration UI and color group rows are removed, saved multi-color palettes remain distinct, CSV/HTML import/export persistence works, WebP export works, and QCDS evidence is updated. Remaining satisfaction risk is storage quota behavior, broader real-user font files, and non-Chromium browser coverage.
